# Termux module notices

Cuplivo includes unmodified library sources from the Termux project at commit
`30ebb2dee381d292ade0f2868cfde0f9f20b89fe`:

- `terminal-emulator`
- `terminal-view`
- `termux-shared`

The terminal emulator and view descend from Android Terminal Emulator. The
Termux project and its contributors retain their respective copyright notices.
The complete applicable license texts are retained under `licenses/`, while
the upstream module-specific scope and exceptions remain in `LICENSE.md` and
`termux-shared/LICENSE.md`.

The Gradle dependency `com.termux:termux-am-library:v2.0.0` is distributed
under Apache License 2.0 and is not copied into this source tree.
